coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: The output matches 5 of 11 ground-truth items (45%): FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit precision, batch size 1, prefill time, decode time, and peak memory usage.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output varies model size rather than holding the specified LLaMa-2-7B model constant, and replaces the e2e/benchmark.py methodology with analytical modeling and extrapolation. It uses a sequence-length sweep with a mandatory length of 1024 rather than fixed 2048, and 256 decode steps rather than 32. Combined end-to-end execution time and explicitly computed speedup factors are missing. Memory is estimated rather than measured during execution.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the expected comparative performance conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, or per-phase speedup of QuaRot 4-bit LLaMa-2 relative to FP16.
